title: AcmeDB 2.0, footnoted
intro: AcmeDB 2.0 adds online snapshots and makes cold starts fast. Both claims have receipts in the changelog.

items.name: Point-in-time snapshots
items.what: Take a consistent snapshot without pausing writes, and restore to any second inside the retention window.

items.name: Manifest compaction
items.what: The manifest no longer grows forever, so cold starts on old databases drop from minutes to seconds.

sources.quote: Snapshots are online, incremental, and restorable to any point in the last seven days.
Cold start on a 500 GB database fell from 4 minutes to 9 seconds.
